name: raw-html-containers
description: Raw HTML containers that should usually compose a layout primitive instead. Surfaces every <section>, <article>, <aside>, <header>, <footer>, <main>, and <nav> in a component body — the agent then decides whether the project has a matching layout primitive (Section, Article, Stack, Row, Grid) and whether to migrate.

anyOf.reason: Compose <Section> or <Stack as="section"> instead of a raw <section>.
Compose <HeaderSurface> at template tier; <Stack as="header"> for in-card headers.
Compose <FooterSurface> at template tier; <Stack as="footer"> for in-card footers.
Only one <main> per page — typically owned by ShellTemplate or an equivalent. Audit.
Compose <NavRow>, <NavTrail>, <NavSidebar>, or <RouteTabs> rather than a raw <nav>.
